wgan_gp.verdict: Promising sharpness and one encouraging listening sample, but not audio-ready because cross-classifier conditioning remains weak and detail overshoots real data for two species.

quick_pilots.verdict: Wiring and CUDA paths pass, but generated token-transformer and diffusion detail energy is 4.6x to 17.4x real data and is consistent with noisy artifacts. These are pilot results, not full-data comparisons.

next_experiment: WGAN-GP v2 with limited-data discriminator augmentation and checkpoint selection based on closeness to real detail plus diversity and cross-classifier consistency.
